get.description: Retrieve the daily API usage for privately distributed apps in the account. This endpoint provides information about the current API usage, usage limits, and usage breakdown by app type. It is useful for monitoring and managing API consumption within your HubSpot account.

Retrieve detailed information about the account associated with the HubSpot portal. This endpoint provides insights into the account type, time zone, currency settings, and data hosting location. It is useful for obtaining a comprehensive overview of the account's configuration and settings.

collectedAt.description: The date and time when the API usage data was collected, in ISO 8601 format.

currentUsage.description: An integer indicating the current amount of API usage.

resetsAt.description: The date and time when the API usage limits will reset, in ISO 8601 format.

usageByAppType.description: An array of objects detailing API usage by application type, each object conforming to the AppTypeUsage schema.

usageLimit.description: An integer representing the maximum allowed API usage.

appType.description: A string indicating the type of application. Valid values include 'LEGACY_PRIVATE_APP', 'PLATFORM_PRIVATE_APP', and 'SERVICE_KEY'.

apps.description: An array of AppUsage objects, each detailing the usage statistics of individual applications within the specified app type.

currentUsage.description: An integer representing the current usage count of the application type.

appId.description: The unique identifier for the app, represented as an integer.

currentUsage.description: The current usage of the app, represented as an integer.

name.description: The name of the app, represented as a string.

context.description: Context about the error condition, represented as an object with additional properties that are arrays of strings.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for the request. Include this value with any error reports or support tickets. It is a UUID format.

errors.description: Further information about the error, represented as an array of ErrorDetail objects.

links.description: A map of link names to associated URIs containing documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate.

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error.

Error.description: Represents an error response returned by the API when an operation fails. This component is used in various endpoints to provide detailed information about the error encountered.

example.message: Invalid input (details will vary based on the error)

code.description: The status code associated with the error detail.

context.description: Context about the error condition, represented as an object with additional properties.

in.description: The name of the field or parameter in which the error was found.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate.

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error.

ErrorDetail.description: Represents detailed information about an error that occurred in the API. This component is used to provide additional context and specifics about errors, typically as part of an error response.

accountType.description: The type of account associated with the portal. Valid values include 'STANDARD', 'DEVELOPER_TEST', 'SANDBOX', and 'APP_DEVELOPER'.

additionalCurrencies.description: An array of additional currencies supported by the portal, each represented as a string.

companyCurrency.description: The primary currency used by the company associated with the portal, represented as a string.

createdAt.description: The creation date of the portal, represented as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

dataHostingLocation.description: The location where the portal's data is hosted, represented as a string.

portalId.description: The unique identifier for the HubSpot portal, represented as an integer.

portalName.description: The name of the portal, represented as a string.

timeZone.description: The time zone setting of the portal, represented as a string.

uiDomain.description: The domain used for the user interface of the portal, represented as a string.

utcOffset.description: The Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) offset for the portal's time zone, represented as a string.

utcOffsetMilliseconds.description: The UTC offset for the portal's time zone, represented in milliseconds as an integer.
